title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 04

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When does the swimming pool open on Sunday?
tasks.audioText: The community sports centre has changed its weekend timetable. The swimming pool opens at eight on Saturday and at nine on Sunday. The gym is closed on Sunday morning for maintenance but opens at one in the afternoon. Members can book a class using the centre's website. Please bring your membership card when you arrive.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Why is the gym closed on Sunday morning?
tasks.audioText: The community sports centre has changed its weekend timetable. The swimming pool opens at eight on Saturday and at nine on Sunday. The gym is closed on Sunday morning for maintenance but opens at one in the afternoon. Members can book a class using the centre's website. Please bring your membership card when you arrive.

tasks.prompt: Reading 1. Read the text. Ben visits the town information office because he wants to find a place to print his college project. The assistant gives him a map and marks a copy shop near the bus station. Ben asks whether the shop accepts card payments. The assistant is not sure, so she writes the shop's telephone number on the map. What service does Ben need?
Reading 2. Why does the assistant give him a telephone number?
options: She is not sure about card payments
Can you tell me where the copy shop is, please?

tasks.prompt: Choose TWO polite expressions for requesting help at a town information office.
Complete: 'A place where you can get information for visitors is an information ___.'
You want to know if a shop accepts cards. What should you ask?
Put the following steps for requesting a service at a shop in a logical order.
options: Check the directions on the map
correctOrder: Check the directions on the map

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words describing a useful facility in your town. Explain where it is, what people can do there and how to ask for information politely.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the facility's location and at least two services/activities available there are described (0–2); the response includes a polite, relevant request for information (0–2); basic grammar and organisation make the description clear (0–2); town/service vocabulary, polite expressions, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
